nonOperational.description: This permission isn't wired to any function yet. Turning it on or off has no effect today.

order_view.label: View orders
order_view.description: Grants access to the order list, each order's detail, its items, and order metrics. Also lets you look up orders over WhatsApp with /orders.

order_view_history.label: View order history
order_view_history.description: Shows the order's status log: which states it went through, who changed them, and when.

order_create.label: Create orders
order_create.description: Lets you place new orders, reorder a customer's favorite order, and generate the catalog link to take an order.

order_edit_items.label: Edit order items
order_edit_items.description: Meant to edit an order's items directly. That's currently covered by "Add", "Update", and "Remove order items".

order_change_status.label: Change order status
order_change_status.description: Moves the order through its fulfillment flow: confirm, preparing, ready, on the way, delivered. Works one at a time or in bulk. Can be restricted to specific statuses.

order_cancel.label: Cancel orders
order_cancel.description: Lets you cancel an order. This action can't be undone. Currently only available over the WhatsApp channel.

order_assign_operator.label: Assign delivery driver
order_assign_operator.description: Lets you assign or reassign the delivery driver for one or several orders. Currently only over the WhatsApp channel.

order_change_payment_status.label: Change payment status
order_change_payment_status.description: Lets you mark an order as paid or correct its payment status, one at a time or in bulk.

order_override_store_closed.label: Confirm while the store is closed
order_override_store_closed.description: Lets you confirm an order even if the branch is outside business hours or marked as closed. Without this permission, the order stays blocked until the branch opens.

order_item_add.label: Add order items
order_item_add.description: Lets you add products to an order that's already been created.

order_item_update.label: Update order items
order_item_update.description: Lets you change the quantity, notes, or variants of a product inside an order.

order_item_delete.label: Remove order items
order_item_delete.description: Lets you remove a product from an existing order.

order_notify_new.label: Receive new-order alerts
order_notify_new.description: Makes this person receive a WhatsApp notification whenever a new order comes in at their branch. It doesn't grant access to anything, it only turns on the alert.

payment_view.label: View payment info
payment_view.description: Meant to view an order's payment detail. That's currently covered by "View orders".

payment_confirm.label: Confirm payment
payment_confirm.description: Meant to confirm an order's payment. That's currently covered by "Change payment status".

delivery_assign_self.label: Self-assign an order
delivery_assign_self.description: Meant to let a driver claim an available order without being assigned. Not implemented yet.

delivery_view_route.label: View delivery route
delivery_view_route.description: Meant to show a driver's delivery route. Not implemented yet.

product_view.label: View products
product_view.description: Meant to control who can see the product catalog. Today, any signed-in team member can see it, regardless of this permission.

product_create.label: Create products
product_create.description: Meant to control who can add products to the catalog. Today, any signed-in team member can create them, regardless of this permission.

product_update.label: Update products
product_update.description: Meant to control who can edit products in the catalog. Today, any signed-in team member can edit them, regardless of this permission.

product_delete.label: Delete products
product_delete.description: Meant to control who can delete products from the catalog. Today, any signed-in team member can delete them, regardless of this permission.

category_view.label: View menu categories
category_view.description: Lets you view the categories used to organize the menu.

category_create.label: Create categories
category_create.description: Lets you add a new category to the menu.

category_update.label: Update categories
category_update.description: Lets you change a category's name, order, and image, reactivate it, and regenerate its search keywords.

category_delete.label: Delete categories
category_delete.description: Lets you deactivate or delete a menu category.

customer_view.label: View customers
customer_view.description: Grants access to the customer base: search by phone, view their order history, their metrics, and their addresses.

customer_create.label: Create customers
customer_create.description: Lets you register new customers and add delivery addresses for them.

customer_update.label: Update customers
customer_update.description: Lets you correct a customer's data, edit their addresses, and set which one is the default.

customer_delete.label: Delete customer addresses
customer_delete.description: Lets you delete a saved delivery address. Does not let you delete the customer.

customer_address_view.label: View customer addresses
customer_address_view.description: Meant as a standalone permission to view addresses. That's currently covered by "View customers".

customer_address_create.label: Create customer addresses
customer_address_create.description: Meant as a standalone permission to create addresses. That's currently covered by "Create customers".

customer_address_update.label: Update customer addresses
customer_address_update.description: Meant as a standalone permission to edit addresses. That's currently covered by "Update customers".

customer_address_delete.label: Delete customer addresses
customer_address_delete.description: Meant as a standalone permission to delete addresses. That's currently covered by "Delete customer addresses" under the Customers domain.

user_view.label: View team
user_view.description: Grants access to the list of active team members and each member's detail.

user_view_all.label: View deactivated members
user_view_all.description: Lets you also see suspended accounts, in addition to active ones.

user_create.label: Add team members
user_create.description: Lets you create new accounts for the team.

user_update.label: Edit team members
user_update.description: Lets you change a team member's data, role, and operator profile.

user_deactivate.label: Suspend team members
user_deactivate.description: Blocks a member's access without deleting their account or history.

user_activate.label: Reactivate team members
user_activate.description: Restores access for a suspended member.

user_delete.label: Delete team members
user_delete.description: Permanently deletes a team member's account.

profile_view.label: View operator profiles
profile_view.description: Lets you view the defined roles (waiter, cashier, driver…) and the permissions each one grants.

profile_create.label: Create operator profiles
profile_create.description: Lets you define a new role.

profile_update.label: Edit profiles and their permissions
profile_update.description: Lets you rename a role and change the permissions it grants. This is the permission that controls this very screen.

profile_assign_permissions.label: Assign permissions to profiles
profile_assign_permissions.description: Meant as a standalone permission to assign permissions. That's currently controlled by "Edit profiles and their permissions".

business_update.label: Edit business
business_update.description: Lets you change the business's data, upload its logo, and request a plan change.

business_deactivate.label: Deactivate business
business_deactivate.description: Takes the business offline: it stops receiving orders and stops serving customers over WhatsApp.

business_ops_manage_operator_profiles.label: Manage operator profiles
business_ops_manage_operator_profiles.description: Meant as a general permission for administering operator profiles. That's currently controlled by the "Operator profiles" domain permissions.

business_ops_manage_users.label: Manage users
business_ops_manage_users.description: Meant as a general permission for administering the team. That's currently controlled by the "Team" domain permissions.

whatsapp_connect.label: Connect WhatsApp
whatsapp_connect.description: Meant to control who connects the business's WhatsApp number. Today that action is controlled by role, not by this permission.

whatsapp_disconnect.label: Disconnect WhatsApp
whatsapp_disconnect.description: Meant to control who disconnects the business's WhatsApp number. Today that action is controlled by role, not by this permission.

whatsapp_view_status.label: View WhatsApp status
whatsapp_view_status.description: Meant to show whether the business's WhatsApp number is connected. Not implemented yet.

whatsapp_send_message.label: Send WhatsApp messages
whatsapp_send_message.description: Meant as a general permission to send messages. To reply to a customer from the inbox, use "Reply to customer".

favorite_view.label: View favorite orders
favorite_view.description: Lets you view the orders a customer saved as regulars.

favorite_create.label: Save favorite orders
favorite_create.description: Lets you save an order as a customer favorite and rename it.

favorite_delete.label: Delete favorite orders
favorite_delete.description: Lets you delete a favorite order.

suggestion_view.label: View suggested products
suggestion_view.description: Shows products customers asked for that aren't on the menu, the ones pending review, and the ranking of most-requested items.

suggestion_approve.label: Approve suggestions
suggestion_approve.description: Turns the suggestion into an actual menu product.

suggestion_reject.label: Reject suggestions
suggestion_reject.description: Discards the suggestion without adding it to the menu.

suggestion_update.label: Edit suggestions
suggestion_update.description: Lets you correct a suggestion before approving or rejecting it.

suggestion_delete.label: Delete suggestions
suggestion_delete.description: Removes the suggestion from the list.

recommendation_view.label: View recommendations
recommendation_view.description: Shows the cross-sell rules between products (what gets suggested alongside what).

recommendation_create.label: Create recommendations
recommendation_create.description: Lets you define which product gets suggested alongside another, e.g. a drink with a pizza.

recommendation_delete.label: Delete recommendations
recommendation_delete.description: Lets you remove recommendations, one at a time or all of a product's at once.

conversation_view.label: Open the inbox
conversation_view.description: Grants access to the WhatsApp inbox: read chat history with customers, mark them as read, view the conversation that led to an order, and see who on the team is available. Also enables real-time updates.

conversation_takeover.label: Take over a chat
conversation_takeover.description: Lets you pull a conversation away from the automated assistant to handle it in person, and hand it back when done.

conversation_send.label: Reply to customer
conversation_send.description: Lets you message the customer over WhatsApp from the inbox and mark yourself as available to assist.

conversation_note.label: Leave internal notes
conversation_note.description: Lets you add notes on a conversation that only the team can see. The customer never receives them.

conversation_assign.label: Assign conversations
conversation_assign.description: Lets you route a chat to another team member and see who it can be assigned to.

conversation_close.label: Close conversations
conversation_close.description: Marks the conversation as handled and removes it from the active inbox.

store_toggle_accepting_orders.label: Open and close the branch
store_toggle_accepting_orders.description: Lets you manually pause or resume order intake for a branch, and revert to the scheduled hours. Works from the panel and over WhatsApp.

metrics_view.label: View business metrics
metrics_view.description: Grants access to sales, revenue, average ticket, branch comparisons, best-selling products, and new customers. Also answers these queries over WhatsApp.

inventory_view.label: View branch availability
inventory_view.description: Lets you check which products are out of stock at a branch. Currently available over the WhatsApp channel.

inventory_set_availability.label: Mark items out of stock
inventory_set_availability.description: Lets you mark a product as out of stock or restore it at a branch, from the panel or over WhatsApp.

table_view.label: View tables
table_view.description: Lets you view a branch's tables and their QR codes.

table_manage.label: Manage tables
table_manage.description: Lets you create, edit, and deactivate tables, and regenerate their QR codes.

billing_view.label: View billing
billing_view.description: Grants access to the subscription's account status, payment history, and billing notices.
